title: Screen controls require looking away from the road
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on screen-based controls and displays requiring drivers to look away from the road, with most examples expressing concern without a clearly classifiable overall sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review still notes that replacing physical controls with screen interactions makes some functions harder to adjust without looking away from the road.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe minor concerns about climate and display controls being harder to glance at quickly, including mentions of looking away from the road and near misses.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the sample gives limited clarity on overall sentiment.
The topic is based on a small, stratified set of excerpts and should not be treated as representative.
Some undetermined fragments are brief and provide limited context, including one fragment that only says it is a very minor concern.
